name: @arena/replay-ui
description: The reusable view model for the Arena environment/trajectory replay viewer (Work Order B011; issue #86): pure, deterministic, frozen-data-driven projections of canonical trajectory/environment/evaluation/verification objects into the shapes the replay surface renders — the replay TIMELINE (append-only steps, per-step action/observation/event records, wall-clock vs logical ordering, honest no-data vs pending gaps), the interactive run-inspection model (step selection, per-step I/O, environment event stream, append-only evidence addresses) and the evaluation/verification RESULT LINKAGE in which every linked artifact carries its OWN truth class (a replayed step is SIMULATION-REPLAY, never 'result'). Zero app dependencies and zero runtime authority: the package depends only on sibling domain/protocol packages, validates every payload through THEIR public guards (malformed or truncated inputs degrade truthfully, never crash) and invents no parallel domain model.
